I will keep the plan steady and labor-saving because I am 64, there are only 2 people in my household, and I have 13.5 mu with well irrigation. I have farmed for 45 years, so I do not want to gamble on anything complicated. I will still plant all three crops, but I will put the largest share into cotton because that is my main cropping system and I know how to manage it well. I will keep some wheat and maize because they spread risk, support household grain needs, and fit local conditions in Hebei. I will use better seed where it clearly helps yield and stability, but I will not overuse fertilizer because that raises cost and can push weak growth or lodging. I will rely on irrigation from my well at the key stages instead of watering too often. For tillage, I will mostly use rotary tillage because it is easier for me to manage on a small farm and works well for seedbed preparation. I will keep pesticide sprays to a moderate level, enough to protect the crop but not excessive. My goal this year is a stable harvest, manageable labor, and controlled input cost rather than chasing the absolute highest yield.
